title: Onderzoek cron comment entity error
description: Cron error (2026-10-19): PluginNotFoundException 'comment entity type does not exist' in EntityTypeManager->getDefinition(). Comment module is niet enabled en geen stale DB-referenties gevonden. Vermoedelijk gewekt door een module-hook tijdens cron. Zoeken welke en fixen.
design: Root cause: Stale entries in Drupal state (field.field.deleted and field.storage.deleted) for comment_body on the comment entity type. The comment module was uninstalled but 'drush field:delete' or similar had already queued the comment_body field for cron purge. FieldPurger::purgeBatch() (web/core/lib/Drupal/Core/Field/FieldPurger.php:131) calls DeletedFieldsRepository::getFieldDefinitions($uniqueStorageId), which does array_filter with closure that calls FieldConfig::getFieldStorageDefinition() on EVERY deleted field. For comment_body: FieldConfig.php:304 calls entity_field.manager->getFieldStorageDefinitions('comment') -> EntityFieldManager::getBaseFieldDefinitions -> EntityTypeManager::getDefinition('comment') -> throws PluginNotFoundException. The first loop's isset() guard protects only itself; the array_filter in the storage-loop bypasses it. Reproduced locally with 'ddev drush cron'. Fix (applied locally): removed comment-targeted entries from state field.field.deleted + field.storage.deleted, dropped empty orphan field_deleted_data_41e50645a5 table, cleaned orphan key_value rows (entity.definitions.bundle_field_map/comment, entity.storage_schema.sql/comment.*, state/comment.maintain_entity_statistics). Production needs same fix via drush @prod ev once release approved.
